assertions.title: Background runner picks up due schedules and advances next run correctly

steps.action: Run dev schedule harness (all phases) and capture runner-disabled behavior
steps.expected: Runner-disabled branch evidence captured for SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED=false
steps.observed: Harness runner-disabled phase had log-tail miss, so branch was re-validated manually with explicit evidence capture.

steps.action: Toggle SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED=false in dev API, restart, and inspect logs
steps.expected: Logs show scheduler disabled and no automatic run during disabled window
steps.observed: Log contained "Scheduler disabled by configuration"; runCount stayed unchanged during >1 poll interval.

steps.expected: Manual run executes once without advancing nextRunAt
steps.observed: Run-now returned 200; runCount incremented; nextRunAt remained unchanged.

steps.action: Restore SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED=true and restart dev API
steps.observed: Log contained "Starting scheduler runner ..." after restore.

assertions.title: Notification delivery results are channel-specific and non-fatal

steps.action: Run harness push-payload phase with push-enabled schedule
steps.expected: Push channel result recorded with channel-specific status and schedule execution preserved
steps.observed: Run-now returned 200; notificationResults.push.status=failed with provider/destination/details; executionResult had conversationId.

steps.action: Inspect payload/delivery evidence for URL-root and no-conversation omission branches
steps.expected: Direct evidence of DOMAIN_CLIENT-rooted /c/<conversationId> link and clean omission when no conversation exists
steps.observed: API-visible run metadata confirms conversation linkage but does not expose delivered payload URL body; no-conversation payload branch not directly exercised in this run.

assertions.issues: Blocked on direct delivery-sink observability for payload URL root verification and on no-conversation payload branch coverage in this environment.

assertions.title: Browser push subscription lifecycle persists and can be removed

steps.action: Run harness push-lifecycle phase (subscribe, resubscribe, unsubscribe)
steps.expected: subscriptionCount increments, idempotent refresh does not double-count, unsubscribe decrements
steps.observed: Subscribe 200 with count 1; resubscribe preserved count 1; unsubscribe 200 lowered count to 0.

steps.expected: 404/410 endpoints pruned and click behavior verified
steps.observed: Synthetic endpoint produced failed delivery without expiredEndpoints; browser-native clickthrough flow not reproducible in runtime-cli isolation.

assertions.issues: Blocked on runtime reproduction of 404/410 stale-endpoint pruning and browser notification click-open behavior.

assertions.title: Model restrictions are enforced server-side across config, chat, agents, and assistants

steps.action: Restrict val-user to openAI:gpt-5.1 via PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}
steps.expected: Restricted user model catalog and config surfaces are filtered server-side
steps.observed: GET /api/models for val-user returned only openAI:gpt-5.1 (others empty); superadmin retained full catalog.

steps.expected: Blocked model attempts rejected with model-access errors
steps.observed: POST /api/agents with gpt-5.4 -> 400 Illegal model request; PATCH existing agent to gpt-5.4 -> 400 Illegal model request.

steps.action: Probe assistant create/chat with blocked model
steps.expected: Blocked model attempts rejected with model-access errors
steps.observed: POST /api/assistants/v1/chat emitted Illegal model request; POST /api/assistants/v1 create returned 500 client-init error before model-access response.

steps.expected: Blocked model path surfaces illegal_model_request style model-access error
steps.observed: POST /api/agents/chat/openAI started stream, but stream ended with "Cannot set headers after they are sent to the client" instead of model-access error payload.

evidence.network: PATCH /api/admin/users/{val-user} -> 200; GET /api/models (restricted) -> 200; POST /api/agents (blocked model) -> 400; PATCH /api/agents/{id} (blocked model) -> 400; POST /api/assistants/v1/chat -> event error Illegal model request; POST /api/assistants/v1 -> 500; POST /api/agents/chat/openAI + stream -> non-contract stream error

assertions.issues: Fail signal: normal chat blocked-model probe did not return a model-access error and assistant create path returned 500 before model-access validation. Additional contract branches (blocked-model duplicate/revert, assistant update, preset/model-spec re-entry) remain unverified in this isolated run.

frictions.description: Harness runner-disabled phase uses sed -i in container /app/.env and hit "Resource busy" during restore in this environment.
frictions.resolution: Switched to in-place Node fs write for SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED toggles and manually verified restore logs.

frictions.description: High-volume blocked-model probes can trigger temporary ban/rate-limit state on validation personas.
frictions.resolution: Repeated approved recovery flow: dev-seed-validation-personas.js + docker restart librechat-dev-api + wait.

blockers.description: No controllable push endpoint/browser permission flow available to force 404/410 pruning and click-open assertions end-to-end.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Used harness synthetic push endpoints plus push-enabled schedule rerun; observed lifecycle and channel result paths but not 404/410 prune or click branch.

blockers.description: Delivered push payload URL body (DOMAIN_CLIENT-rooted /c/<id>) is not directly observable from available API response surface in this isolation.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Ran harness push-payload phase with successful conversation-producing schedule and captured channel/result metadata.

blockers.description: Full VAL-MODEL-003 matrix branches requiring blocked-model duplicate/revert history and assistant create/update success path were not fully reproducible in this environment.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Expanded probes across /api/models, /api/config, /api/agents create/update/duplicate/revert, /api/assistants create/chat, and /api/agents/chat stream.

actions: Deleted temporary round5 schedules and agents created for validation probes.
Disabled push in val-superadmin notification settings after push-phase tests.
Reseeded validation personas and restarted dev API to clear temporary bans/locks and restore baseline.

summary: Tested 4 assigned assertions on dev rail: 1 pass (VAL-SCHED-006), 1 fail (VAL-MODEL-003), 2 blocked (VAL-SCHED-008, VAL-SCHED-009). Schedule harness validation is materially improved with concrete lifecycle and runner-disabled evidence; remaining schedule blockers are delivery-observability branches. Model-restriction matrix still has a gap: normal chat blocked-model probe did not yield a model-access error and assistant-create blocked-model path still returns a pre-validation 500 in this environment.
